game_title: Trace Table Race – Moat Bridge Rush
game_concept: A action puzzle set in The Kingdom – Moat Bridge, the drawbridge over the moat: the town guard must handle rogue crows while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Trace Table Race: Fill a trace table showing each variable after every line of a mini program.
theme: The Kingdom – Moat Bridge: the drawbridge over the moat
core_gameplay_loop: In Moat Bridge, repeat each round: Fill a trace table showing each variable after every line of a mini program. Each round, a new arrows challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the trace_rows_correct value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 340 points of arrows by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 340, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 7 (applied tier): Trace Table Race
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Trace Table Race' (Week 1 slot 14), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Moat Bridge'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how trace_rows_correct changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rogue crows in Moat Bridge.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 340 within 48 seconds.
